## Summary

Describe the problem and what changes for users or contributors.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Identify checks that require external
data or software.

## Migration notes

- [ ] I checked whether this change affects results, axes, supported formats,
  warnings, or API compatibility.

State whether a migration note is needed. If it is, update the
[migration guide](https://github.com/spectrochempy/nmrglue-ng/blob/master/doc/source/migration.rst) and explain what changes and
what users should verify or recompute.

Verify every release version cited in a migration note against its published
Git tag. Check that the tagged source contains the change. For an unreleased
change, leave the version unspecified until it can be verified.
